tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Conversation pane and window background.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Edge-to-edge conversation list. Runs flush to the window edge, no inset card, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Unified toolbar and composer bar tint, over a background blur. Default is deliberately on the opaque side so text above scrolling content stays legible.

tokens.name: surface-glass-clear
tokens.usage: Clearest end of the glass range. Only over plain surfaces, never over photos or conversation backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-glass-tinted
tokens.usage: Fully tinted end of the glass range, and the fallback when transparency is reduced.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge on glass surfaces. Decorative: separation is also carried by the tint.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Inner top highlight on glass surfaces and floating controls.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline between sidebar and conversation pane, and between list sections. Decorative.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-window, surface-sidebar, surface-glass-tinted and bubble-received.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Message previews, timestamps, delivery status on surface-window and surface-sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Composer and search placeholder text on field.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sent bubbles, selected sidebar row, primary buttons, unread dot. Fill only; pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and bubble-fallback.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and text buttons on surface-window and surface-sidebar.

tokens.name: bubble-sent
tokens.usage: Outgoing message bubble on the rich channel. Text in on-accent.

tokens.name: bubble-fallback
tokens.usage: Outgoing bubble on the fallback (plain text) channel. Text in on-accent. Differs from bubble-sent in hue only, so always also label the channel in the composer placeholder.

tokens.name: bubble-received
tokens.usage: Incoming message bubble. Text in ink.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Composer and search field fill.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Composer and search field outline on surface-window, surface-sidebar and surface-glass-tinted.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px solid focus ring on any surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Not Delivered text and destructive actions on surface-window. Always with an icon or the words.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Unread count fill. Count in on-accent.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Conversation name in the toolbar and in a sidebar row.

styles.name: message
styles.usage: Message text in bubbles and the composer.

styles.name: preview
styles.usage: Two-line message preview in a sidebar row, in ink-secondary.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, Delivered and Read status, sender name above a group bubble.

styles.name: meta-strong
styles.usage: Day separators in the transcript; badge counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between consecutive bubbles from the same sender.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label; bubble to its status line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Bubble vertical padding; gap between sender groups; sidebar row inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Bubble horizontal padding; sidebar row padding; toolbar item gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Transcript side margins; composer bar padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap around day separators; sheet padding.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Sidebar row selection, menu items, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Window corners, sheets, popovers. Moderate on purpose; inner panes meeting the window edge take no radius of their own.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Message bubbles, composer field, attachment cards.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Toolbar button groups, search field, badges, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass controls and popovers. Never on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Active window. Halve the opacity for inactive windows.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Default conversation list width; resizable 240 to 400px.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Unified toolbar spanning sidebar and conversation pane.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Sidebar conversation row: avatar, name, two-line preview.

tokens.name: avatar-size
tokens.usage: Sidebar avatar. 28px beside group bubbles.

tokens.name: bubble-max-width
tokens.usage: Longest bubble relative to the transcript width.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Background blur radius under surface-glass.
